passages.text: In the twelfth year, on the first day of the twelfth month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, take up a lament for Pharaoh king of Egypt and say to him: ‘You are like a lion among the nations; you are like a monster in the seas. You thrash about in your rivers, churning up the waters with your feet and muddying the streams.’
passages.sermon:
The word of the LORD came to me.
This happened in the twelfth year.
It was the first day of the twelfth month.
God spoke to me.
He called me “son of man.”
He told me to take up a lament.
This lament was for Pharaoh, king of Egypt.
God told me to speak to Pharaoh.
Pharaoh is like a young lion among the nations.
Pharaoh is also like a monster in the seas.
Pharaoh thrashes about in his rivers.
He churns up the waters with his feet.
He muddies the streams.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בִּשְׁתֵּ֣י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה בִּשְׁנֵי־ עָשָׂ֥ר חֹ֖דֶשׁ בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ בֶּן־ אָדָ֗ם שָׂ֤א קִינָה֙ עַל־ פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֔יִם וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֔יו כְּפִ֥יר גּוֹיִ֖ם נִדְמֵ֑יתָ וְאַתָּה֙ כַּתַּנִּ֣ים בַּיַּמִּ֔ים וַתָּ֣גַח בְּנַהֲרוֹתֶ֗יךָ וַתִּדְלַח־ מַ֙יִם֙ בְּרַגְלֶ֔יךָ וַתִּרְפֹּ֖ס נַהֲרוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I will spread My net over you with a company of many peoples, and they will draw you up in My net.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He addresses Pharaoh, king of Egypt.
He says, “I will act against you.
I will spread My net over you.
I will gather a large group of many nations.
They will help Me.
They will pull you up in My net.
passages.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וּפָרַשְׂתִּ֤י עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ אֶת־ רִשְׁתִּ֔י בִּקְהַ֖ל עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְהֶעֱל֖וּךָ בְּחֶרְמִֽי׃

passages.text: I will abandon you on the land and hurl you into the open field. I will cause all the birds of the air to settle upon you, and all the beasts of the earth to eat their fill of you.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Ezekiel.
God gave a message about Pharaoh, the king of Egypt.
God said, “I will abandon you, Pharaoh, on the land.
I will throw you into the open field.
I will bring all the birds of the sky to settle on you.
I will let all the wild animals of the earth eat their fill from you.”
passages.original: וּנְטַשְׁתִּ֣יךָ בָאָ֔רֶץ עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה אֲטִילֶ֑ךָ וְהִשְׁכַּנְתִּ֤י עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ כָּל־ ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְהִשְׂבַּעְתִּ֥י מִמְּךָ֖ חַיַּ֥ת כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: I will put your flesh on the mountains and fill the valleys with your remains.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He acts with power and judgment.
He will put your flesh on the mountains.
He will fill the valleys with your remains.
passages.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י אֶת־ בְּשָׂרְךָ֖ עַל־ הֶֽהָרִ֑ים וּמִלֵּאתִ֥י הַגֵּאָי֖וֹת רָמוּתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: I will drench the land with the flow of your blood, all the way to the mountains— the ravines will be filled.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to a nation that has sinned.
God says, “I will drench your land with your blood.
Your blood will flow all the way to the mountains.
The ravines will fill up with your blood.”
passages.original: וְהִשְׁקֵיתִ֨י אֶ֧רֶץ צָפָתְךָ֛ מִדָּמְךָ֖ אֶל־ הֶֽהָרִ֑ים וַאֲפִקִ֖ים יִמָּלְא֥וּן מִמֶּֽךָּ׃

passages.text: When I extinguish you, I will cover the heavens and darken their stars. I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon will not give its light.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to a nation facing judgment.
God says, “When I extinguish you, I will act.”
I will cover the heavens.
I will darken the stars in the sky.
I will cover the sun with a cloud.
The moon will not give its light.
passages.original: וְכִסֵּיתִ֤י בְכַבּֽוֹתְךָ֙ שָׁמַ֔יִם וְהִקְדַּרְתִּ֖י אֶת־ כֹּֽכְבֵיהֶ֑ם שֶׁ֚מֶשׁ בֶּעָנָ֣ן אֲכַסֶּ֔נּוּ וְיָרֵ֖חַ לֹא־ יָאִ֥יר אוֹרֽוֹ׃

passages.text: All the shining lights in the heavens I will darken over you, and I will bring darkness upon your land,’ declares the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
The Lord GOD has all power.
The Lord GOD declares His judgment.
I will darken all the shining lights in the heavens over you.
I will bring darkness upon your land.
passages.original: כָּל־ מְא֤וֹרֵי אוֹר֙ בַּשָּׁמַ֔יִם אַקְדִּירֵ֖ם עָלֶ֑יךָ וְנָתַ֤תִּי חֹ֙שֶׁךְ֙ עַֽל־ אַרְצְךָ֔ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

passages.text: ‘I will trouble the hearts of many peoples, when I bring about your destruction among the nations, in countries you do not know.
passages.sermon:
God speaks these words.
God says, “I will trouble the hearts of many peoples.
I will do this when I bring your destruction among the nations.
I will bring you down in countries you do not know.”
passages.original: וְהִ֨כְעַסְתִּ֔י לֵ֖ב עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים בַּהֲבִיאִ֤י שִׁבְרְךָ֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם עַל־ אֲרָצ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ יְדַעְתָּֽם׃

passages.text: I will cause many peoples to be appalled over you, and their kings will shudder in horror because of you when I brandish My sword before them. On the day of your downfall each of them will tremble every moment for his life.’
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to Egypt.
He will bring many peoples against Egypt.
He will make these peoples appalled at Egypt.
Their kings will see Egypt’s fate.
These kings will shudder in horror because of Egypt.
The Lord will brandish His sword before these kings.
On the day Egypt falls, each king will tremble.
Each person will fear for his own life every moment.
passages.original: וַהֲשִׁמּוֹתִ֨י עָלֶ֜יךָ עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים וּמַלְכֵיהֶם֙ יִשְׂעֲר֤וּ עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ שַׂ֔עַר בְּעוֹפְפִ֥י חַרְבִּ֖י עַל־ פְּנֵיהֶ֑ם וְחָרְד֤וּ לִרְגָעִים֙ אִ֣ישׁ לְנַפְשׁ֔וֹ בְּי֖וֹם מַפַּלְתֶּֽךָ׃ס

passages.text: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘The sword of the king of Babylon will come against you!
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He is the ruler over all.
He gives a warning.
The king of Babylon has a sword.
This sword will come against you.
The king of Babylon will attack you.
passages.original: כִּ֛י כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה חֶ֥רֶב מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל תְּבוֹאֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: I will make your hordes fall by the swords of the mighty, the most ruthless of all nations. They will ravage the pride of Egypt and all her multitudes will be destroyed.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Egypt.
God is powerful and judges nations.
God will use mighty warriors against Egypt.
These warriors are the most ruthless of all nations.
God will make Egypt’s hordes fall by their swords.
These warriors will attack Egypt’s pride.
They will ravage Egypt’s greatness.
All the people of Egypt will be destroyed.
passages.original: בְּחַרְב֤וֹת גִּבּוֹרִים֙ אַפִּ֣יל הֲמוֹנֶ֔ךָ עָרִיצֵ֥י גוֹיִ֖ם כֻּלָּ֑ם וְשָֽׁדְדוּ֙ אֶת־ גְּא֣וֹן מִצְרַ֔יִם וְנִשְׁמַ֖ד כָּל־ הֲמוֹנָֽהּ׃

passages.text: I will slaughter all her cattle beside the abundant waters. No human foot will muddy them again, and no cattle hooves will disturb them.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks about Egypt.
God will destroy all the cattle of Egypt.
God will do this beside Egypt’s many waters.
No human foot will muddy these waters again.
No animal hoof will disturb these waters again.
passages.original: וְהַֽאֲבַדְתִּי֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ בְּהֶמְתָּ֔הּ מֵעַ֖ל מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים וְלֹ֨א תִדְלָחֵ֤ם רֶֽגֶל־ אָדָם֙ ע֔וֹד וּפַרְס֥וֹת בְּהֵמָ֖ה לֹ֥א תִדְלָחֵֽם׃

passages.text: Then I will let her waters settle and will make her rivers flow like oil,’ declares the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon: The Lord GOD speaks.\r\nHe will let Egypt’s waters settle.\r\nHe will make Egypt’s rivers flow smoothly, like oil.
passages.original: אָ֚ז אַשְׁקִ֣יעַ מֵֽימֵיהֶ֔ם וְנַהֲרוֹתָ֖ם כַּשֶּׁ֣מֶן אוֹלִ֑יךְ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

passages.text: ‘When I make the land of Egypt a desolation and empty it of all that filled it, when I strike down all who live there, then they will know that I am the LORD.’
passages.sermon:
The Lord is speaking.
The Lord will make the land of Egypt empty.
The Lord will make Egypt a wasteland.
The Lord will remove everything that filled Egypt.
The Lord will strike down all people who live in Egypt.
Then the people will know that the Lord is God.
passages.original: בְּתִתִּי֩ אֶת־ אֶ֨רֶץ מִצְרַ֜יִם שְׁמָמָ֣ה וּנְשַׁמָּ֗ה אֶ֚רֶץ מִמְּלֹאָ֔הּ בְּהַכּוֹתִ֖י אֶת־ כָּל־ י֣וֹשְׁבֵי בָ֑הּ וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: This is the lament they will chant for her; the daughters of the nations will chant it. Over Egypt and all her multitudes they will chant it, declares the Lord GOD.”
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He declares a message about Egypt.
This message is a lament.
People will chant this lament for Egypt.
The daughters of the nations will chant it.
They will chant it over Egypt.
They will chant it over all Egypt’s multitudes.
The Lord GOD has spoken.
passages.original: קִינָ֥ה הִיא֙ וְק֣וֹנְנ֔וּהָ בְּנ֥וֹת הַגּוֹיִ֖ם תְּקוֹנֵ֣נָּה אוֹתָ֑הּ עַל־ מִצְרַ֤יִם וְעַל־ כָּל־ הֲמוֹנָהּ֙ תְּקוֹנֵ֣נָּה אוֹתָ֔הּ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ

passages.text: In the twelfth year, on the fifteenth day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, wail for the multitudes of Egypt, and consign her and the daughters of the mighty nations to the depths of the earth with those who descend to the Pit: Whom do you surpass in beauty? Go down and be placed with the uncircumcised!
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He spoke in the twelfth year.
He spoke on the fifteenth day of the month.
He said these words to me.
He called me "Son of man."
He told me to wail for the multitudes of Egypt.
He told me to consign Egypt to the depths of the earth.
He told me to consign the daughters of mighty nations with her.
He said they will go to the depths with those who descend to the Pit.
He asked, "Whom do you surpass in beauty?"
He commanded, "Go down."
He commanded, "Be placed with the uncircumcised."
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בִּשְׁתֵּ֣י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם נְהֵ֛ה עַל־ הֲמ֥וֹן מִצְרַ֖יִם וְהוֹרִדֵ֑הוּ א֠וֹתָהּ וּבְנ֨וֹת גּוֹיִ֧ם אַדִּרִ֛ם אֶל־ אֶ֥רֶץ תַּחְתִּיּ֖וֹת אֶת־ י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃ מִמִּ֖י נָעָ֑מְתָּ רְדָ֥ה וְהָשְׁכְּבָ֖ה אֶת־ עֲרֵלִֽים׃

passages.text: They will fall among those slain by the sword. The sword is appointed! Let them drag her away along with all her multitudes.
passages.sermon: Egypt and her multitudes will fall among those killed by the sword.\r\nGod has appointed the sword for them.\r\nOthers will drag Egypt and all her people away.
passages.original: בְּת֥וֹךְ חַלְלֵי־ חֶ֖רֶב יִפֹּ֑לוּ חֶ֣רֶב נִתָּ֔נָה מָשְׁכ֥וּ אוֹתָ֖הּ וְכָל־ הֲמוֹנֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: Mighty chiefs will speak from the midst of Sheol about Egypt and her allies: ‘They have come down and lie with the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword.’
passages.sermon:
Mighty chiefs are in Sheol.
Sheol is the place of the dead.
These chiefs speak from the midst of Sheol.
They speak about Egypt and her allies.
Egypt and her allies have come down to Sheol.
They lie with the uncircumcised.
They lie with those slain by the sword.
passages.original: יְדַבְּרוּ־ ל֞וֹ אֵלֵ֧י גִבּוֹרִ֛ים מִתּ֥וֹךְ שְׁא֖וֹל אֶת־ עֹֽזְרָ֑יו יָֽרְד֛וּ שָׁכְב֥וּ הָעֲרֵלִ֖ים חַלְלֵי־ חָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: Assyria is there with her whole company; her graves are all around her. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword.
passages.sermon:
Assyria is there.
Her whole company is with her.
Her graves surround her.
All of them are slain.
They have fallen by the sword.
passages.original: שָׁ֤ם אַשּׁוּר֙ וְכָל־ קְהָלָ֔הּ סְבִֽיבוֹתָ֖יו קִבְרֹתָ֑יו כֻּלָּ֣ם חֲלָלִ֔ים הַנֹּפְלִ֖ים בֶּחָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: Her graves are set in the depths of the Pit, and her company is all around her grave. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword— those who once spread terror in the land of the living.
passages.sermon:
This passage describes a nation that once spread terror in the land of the living.
Her graves are placed deep in the Pit.
Her people surround her grave.
All of them are dead.
They fell by the sword.
They are the ones who spread fear while they lived.
passages.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִתְּנ֤וּ קִבְרֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ בְּיַרְכְּתֵי־ ב֔וֹר וַיְהִ֣י קְהָלָ֔הּ סְבִיב֖וֹת קְבֻרָתָ֑הּ כֻּלָּ֤ם חֲלָלִים֙ נֹפְלִ֣ים בַּחֶ֔רֶב אֲשֶׁר־ נָתְנ֥וּ חִתִּ֖ית בְּאֶ֥רֶץ חַיִּֽים׃

passages.text: Elam is there with all her multitudes around her grave. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword— those who went down uncircumcised to the earth below, who once spread their terror in the land of the living. They bear their disgrace with those who descend to the Pit.
passages.sermon:
Elam is there.
Elam has all her multitudes with her.
Their graves surround her grave.
All of them are slain.
They have fallen by the sword.
They went down uncircumcised to the earth below.
They once spread terror in the land of the living.
They now bear their disgrace.
They share this disgrace with those who descend to the Pit.
passages.original: שָׁ֤ם עֵילָם֙ וְכָל־ הֲמוֹנָ֔הּ סְבִיב֖וֹת קְבֻרָתָ֑הּ כֻּלָּ֣ם חֲלָלִים֩ הַנֹּפְלִ֨ים בַּחֶ֜רֶב אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ יָרְד֥וּ עֲרֵלִ֣ים׀ אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ תַּחְתִּיּ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתְנ֤וּ חִתִּיתָם֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּ֔ים וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ כְלִמָּתָ֖ם אֶת־ י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃

passages.text: Among the slain they prepare a resting place for Elam with all her hordes, with her graves all around her. All of them are uncircumcised, slain by the sword, although their terror was once spread in the land of the living. They bear their disgrace with those who descend to the Pit. They are placed among the slain.
passages.sermon:
Elam is a nation.
Elam has many people.
They prepare a resting place for Elam among the slain.
All of Elam’s graves are around her.
All of Elam’s people are uncircumcised.
All of them were killed by the sword.
Elam once spread terror in the land of the living.
Now Elam’s people bear their disgrace with those who go down to the Pit.
They are placed among the slain.
passages.original: בְּת֣וֹךְ חֲ֠לָלִים נָתְנ֨וּ מִשְׁכָּ֥ב לָהּ֙ בְּכָל־ הֲמוֹנָ֔הּ סְבִֽיבוֹתָ֖יו קִבְרֹתֶ֑הָ כֻּלָּ֣ם עֲרֵלִ֣ים חַלְלֵי־ חֶ֡רֶב כִּֽי־ נִתַּ֨ן חִתִּיתָ֜ם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּ֗ים וַיִּשְׂא֤וּ כְלִמָּתָם֙ אֶת־ י֣וֹרְדֵי ב֔וֹר בְּת֥וֹךְ חֲלָלִ֖ים נִתָּֽן׃

passages.text: Meshech and Tubal are there with all their multitudes, with their graves all around them. All of them are uncircumcised, slain by the sword, because they spread their terror in the land of the living.
passages.sermon:
Meshech and Tubal are there.
All their multitudes are with them.
Their graves surround them.
All of them are uncircumcised.
All of them were slain by the sword.
They spread terror in the land of the living.
passages.original: שָׁ֣ם מֶ֤שֶׁךְ תֻּבַל֙ וְכָל־ הֲמוֹנָ֔הּ סְבִֽיבוֹתָ֖יו קִבְרוֹתֶ֑יהָ כֻּלָּ֤ם עֲרֵלִים֙ מְחֻ֣לְלֵי חֶ֔רֶב כִּֽי־ נָתְנ֥וּ חִתִּיתָ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ חַיִּֽים׃

passages.text: They do not lie down with the fallen warriors of old, who went down to Sheol with their weapons of war, whose swords were placed under their heads, whose shields rested on their bones, although the terror of the mighty was once in the land of the living.
passages.sermon:
The fallen warriors of old are mighty men.
They went down to Sheol with their weapons of war.
People placed their swords under their heads.
Their shields rested on their bones.
These mighty men once caused terror in the land of the living.
But others do not lie down with these mighty fallen warriors.
They remain separate from them.
passages.original: וְלֹ֤א יִשְׁכְּבוּ֙ אֶת־ גִּבּוֹרִ֔ים נֹפְלִ֖ים מֵעֲרֵלִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָרְדֽוּ־ שְׁא֣וֹל בִּכְלֵֽי־ מִלְחַמְתָּם֩ וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ אֶת־ חַרְבוֹתָ֜ם תַּ֣חַת רָאשֵׁיהֶ֗ם וַתְּהִ֤י עֲוֺֽנֹתָם֙ עַל־ עַצְמוֹתָ֔ם כִּֽי־ חִתִּ֥ית גִּבּוֹרִ֖ים בְּאֶ֥רֶץ חַיִּֽים׃

passages.text: But you too will be shattered and lie down among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword.
passages.sermon: You will be among the uncircumcised.\r\nYou will be broken there.\r\nYou will lie with those killed by the sword.
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֗ה בְּת֧וֹךְ עֲרֵלִ֛ים תִּשָּׁבַ֥ר וְתִשְׁכַּ֖ב אֶת־ חַלְלֵי־ חָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: Edom is there, and all her kings and princes, who despite their might are laid among those slain by the sword. They lie down with the uncircumcised, with those who descend to the Pit.
passages.sermon:
Edom is there.
All her kings are there.
All her princes are there.
They were mighty.
But they were killed by the sword.
They lie with the uncircumcised.
They lie with those who go down to the Pit.
passages.original: שָׁ֣מָּה אֱד֗וֹם מְלָכֶ֙יהָ֙ וְכָל־ נְשִׂיאֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁר־ נִתְּנ֥וּ בִגְבוּרָתָ֖ם אֶת־ חַלְלֵי־ חָ֑רֶב הֵ֛מָּה אֶת־ עֲרֵלִ֥ים יִשְׁכָּ֖בוּ וְאֶת־ יֹ֥רְדֵי בֽוֹר׃

passages.text: All the leaders of the north and all the Sidonians are there; they went down in disgrace with the slain, despite the terror of their might. They lie uncircumcised with those slain by the sword and bear their shame with those who descend to the Pit.
passages.sermon:
All the leaders of the north are there.
All the Sidonians are there.
They went down with the slain.
They went down in disgrace.
They once inspired terror with their might.
Now they lie uncircumcised.
They lie with those slain by the sword.
They bear their shame.
They share shame with those who descend to the Pit.
passages.original: שָׁ֣מָּה נְסִיכֵ֥י צָפ֛וֹן כֻּלָּ֖ם וְכָל־ צִֽדֹנִ֑י אֲשֶׁר־ יָרְד֣וּ אֶת־ חֲלָלִ֗ים בְּחִתִּיתָ֤ם מִגְבֽוּרָתָם֙ בּוֹשִׁ֔ים וַיִּשְׁכְּב֤וּ עֲרֵלִים֙ אֶת־ חַלְלֵי־ חֶ֔רֶב וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ כְלִמָּתָ֖ם אֶת־ י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃

passages.text: Pharaoh will see them and be comforted over all his multitude— Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh is the king of Egypt.
Pharaoh will see these other nations.
These nations are Edom, the leaders of the north, and the Sidonians.
They are all dead.
They were powerful, but they were killed by the sword.
Pharaoh will see them.
Pharaoh will feel comfort about his own people.
Pharaoh and all his army were also killed by the sword.
The Lord GOD says this.
passages.original: אוֹתָם֙ יִרְאֶ֣ה פַרְעֹ֔ה וְנִחַ֖ם עַל־ כָּל־ הֲמוֹנֹה חַלְלֵי־ חֶ֙רֶב֙ פַּרְעֹ֣ה וְכָל־ חֵיל֔וֹ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

passages.text: For I will spread My terror in the land of the living, so that Pharaoh and all his multitude will be laid to rest among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.”
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He says, "I will spread My terror in the land of the living.
I will cause fear among the people who are alive.
Pharaoh is the king of Egypt.
Pharaoh has a great multitude, which means his many people and his army.
Pharaoh and all his multitude will be laid to rest.
They will lie among the uncircumcised.
They will lie with those who were killed by the sword.
This is what the Lord GOD declares."
passages.original: כִּֽי־ נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת־ חִתִּיתוֹ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּ֑ים וְהֻשְׁכַּב֩ בְּת֨וֹךְ עֲרֵלִ֜ים אֶת־ חַלְלֵי־ חֶ֗רֶב פַּרְעֹה֙ וְכָל־ הֲמוֹנֹ֔ה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ
